title: jams engine scene for platformer, format v3

$schema.description: Path or URI of this file's JSON Schema, for editors. Ignored by the engine.

v.description: Scene format version. Files are migrated up on load and always saved at the current version.

game.description: The game whose registered types this scene uses.
game.title: Game

name.description: Scene name, same rules as an id; matches the file name without .json.
name.title: Name

bounds.description: World rectangle [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] in px; y is down. Limits the camera; anything outside it is flagged.
bounds.title: Bounds

settings.description: Scene-wide settings: the engine's, then the game's.
settings.title: Settings

gravity.description: World gravity [x, y] in px/s²; y is down. Omitted: the project's, else the game's default.
gravity.title: Gravity

physics.description: The physics world: "rapier" simulates bodies, "none" runs without one. Omitted resolves through the project and game defaults to "rapier".
physics.title: Physics

grid.description: The scene's one cell grid, square or hex; the hex parameters match Tiled's. Omitted: the game's world grid, else none.
grid.title: Grid

cell.description: Cell size [w, h], px; positive integers.

origin.description: Where cell 0, 0 starts, world px; integers. Omitted means 0, 0.

cell.description: The hex's bounding box [w, h], px (Tiled's tilewidth, tileheight); positive integers.

side.description: The length of the flat sides, px (Tiled's hexsidelength): an integer from 0 to the cell's size on the stagger axis.

index.description: Whether odd or even rows (or columns) are shifted (Tiled's staggerindex).

origin.description: Where cell 0, 0 starts, world px; integers. Omitted means 0, 0.

view.description: How the scene is projected to the screen; reserved, only orthogonal exists.
view.title: View

projection.description: The only projection there is so far.

assets.description: Asset ids only game code names, so they count as used: sorted, each once.
assets.title: Assets

groups.description: Groups by id. An entity or instance whose `group` names one stores its geometry relative to the group's `at`.

instances.description: Prefab instances, each a copy of a prefab file placed at `at`.

anchor.description: Grapple anchor points, absolute px; ops refer to them as ~anchor:<index>. Entries have no id; ops refer to them as ~anchor:<index>.

items.description: Anchor position. Absolute world px; y is down.
items.title: Position

cloud.description: One-way cloud platforms, box only, absolute px. Entries have no id; ops refer to them as ~cloud:<index>.

items.description: Collider shape, box only. Absolute world px; y is down.
items.title: Shape

solid.description: Static ground shapes, absolute px; `solid:<material>` for a material. Entries have no id; ops refer to them as ~solid:<index>.

items.description: Collider shape. Absolute world px; y is down. Any tag, including chain for outlines.
items.title: Shape

solid:chocolate.description: Static ground shapes, absolute px; `solid:<material>` for a material. Material chocolate: slows movement. Entries have no id; ops refer to them as ~solid:chocolate:<index>.

items.description: Collider shape. Absolute world px; y is down. Any tag, including chain for outlines.
items.title: Shape

solid:ice.description: Static ground shapes, absolute px; `solid:<material>` for a material. Material ice: low friction, the player slides. Entries have no id; ops refer to them as ~solid:ice:<index>.

items.description: Collider shape. Absolute world px; y is down. Any tag, including chain for outlines.
items.title: Shape

solid:trampoline.description: Static ground shapes, absolute px; `solid:<material>` for a material. Material trampoline: bounces the player up. Entries have no id; ops refer to them as ~solid:trampoline:<index>.

items.description: Collider shape. Absolute world px; y is down. Any tag, including chain for outlines.
items.title: Shape

spawn.description: Player spawn points (feet), absolute px. Entries have no id; ops refer to them as ~spawn:<index>.

items.description: The player's FEET, so put it on a floor's top edge. One per player; spawns 60px apart or more.
items.title: Position

entities.description: Entities with stable ids: anything that moves, has parameters, or is referenced.

description: A jams engine scene. Units are integer pixels with y pointing down. Simple static geometry lives in the bulk arrays; everything else is an entity.

at.description: The group's origin in world px. Members store their geometry relative to it, so moving the group is one edit here.
at.title: Origin

rot.description: Quarter turns clockwise (y down), applied after `flip`. Omitted means 0.
rot.title: Rotation

flip.description: Mirror x in the local frame, before `rot`. Omitted means not mirrored.
flip.title: Mirror

name.description: Display label for the editor's outliner. No runtime effect.
name.title: Name

Group.description: A group of entities and instances that move together around a local origin.

id.description: Stable id, unique in the scene: lowercase letters, digits and '-', 1-48 characters, starting with a letter or digit. Ops and other entities refer to the entity by it.
id.title: Id

prefab.description: The prefab placed here: the file prefabs/<prefab>.json beside the scene.
prefab.title: Prefab

name.description: Display label for the editor's outliner. No runtime effect.
name.title: Name

layer.description: Scene layer, one of the game's layers; omitted means the type's default. The editor shows, hides and locks entities by layer, and the engine's own visuals draw on it; a type's shape visuals keep the draw layer their system chooses.
layer.title: Layer

group.description: The declared group (top-level `groups`) this belongs to. Its geometry is stored relative to the group's `at`, and members select and move together.
group.title: Group

off.description: When true the entity stays in the file but is not loaded, e.g. to A/B a change without deleting it.
off.title: Disabled

z.description: Added to the z of every child, an integer in [-10000, 10000]. Omitted means 0.
z.title: Z

at.description: Where the prefab's origin lands, in world px (relative to the group's origin when in a group).
at.title: Position

rot.description: Quarter turns clockwise (y down), applied after `flip`. Omitted means 0.
rot.title: Rotation

flip.description: Mirror x in the local frame, before `rot`. Omitted means not mirrored.
flip.title: Mirror

params.description: Values of the prefab's exposed parameters, by name.
params.title: Parameters

overrides.description: Child fields that differ from the prefab, keyed `<childId>.<field.path>` (`door.path.speed`, `~solid:0.shape`). Values are in the prefab's own frame, before `at`.
overrides.title: Overrides

Instance.description: One placement of a prefab. Its children load with ids `<id>/<childId>`, mirrored by `flip`, turned by `rot` and moved by `at`.

Pt.description: A point [x, y] in integer world pixels; y is down.

BoxShape.description: A shape tuple: ["box", cx, cy, hw, hh, rotDeg?]. Integer pixels, y is down.

oneOf.title: box
oneOf.description: Axis-aligned box (a Rapier cuboid) by centre and half-extents, optionally rotated about its centre.

prefixItems.description: Rotation in integer degrees, clockwise on screen (y is down). Omitted means 0.

ShapeTuple.description: A shape tuple: ["box", cx, cy, hw, hh, rotDeg?] | ["circle", cx, cy, r] | ["capsule", cx, cy, halfLen, r, rotDeg?] | ["poly", x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, ...] | ["chain", x1, y1, x2, y2, ...]. Integer pixels, y is down.

oneOf.title: box
oneOf.description: Axis-aligned box (a Rapier cuboid) by centre and half-extents, optionally rotated about its centre.

prefixItems.description: Rotation in integer degrees, clockwise on screen (y is down). Omitted means 0.

oneOf.title: circle
oneOf.description: Circle (a Rapier ball) by centre and radius.

oneOf.title: capsule
oneOf.description: Capsule, vertical before rotation: a segment of half-length halfLen through the centre, swept by radius r.

prefixItems.description: Half the length of the inner segment.
Rotation in integer degrees, clockwise on screen (y is down). Omitted means 0.

oneOf.title: poly
oneOf.description: Convex polygon as flat x, y pairs (at least 3 points). Points are absolute; the loader centres the body on their centroid. Concave outlines must be split or drawn as a chain.

oneOf.title: chain
oneOf.description: Open polyline as flat x, y pairs (at least 2 points), for static terrain. Allowed on solid and sensor only.

shape.description: Collider shape. Absolute world px; y is down. Any tag, including chain for outlines.

oneWay.title: One-way
oneWay.description: The one side actors collide with: they pass through from every other side and land on this one. `true` is "up": they pass up through it and land on top.

attach.description: A path follower's id: the collider rides that follower's body, keeping its offset from the follower's first path point.

y: 0 the frame's top, 1 its bottom.

offset.description: World px from the pose to the anchor; turns and flips with the instance.

tint.description: 0xRRGGBB multiplied into the texture; default the material's, else none.

flipX.description: Mirror left–right; an instance flip toggles it.

blend.description: How it composites over what is below; default the material's, else normal.

nineSlice.description: Insets in texture px; default the import's.

turn.description: Turn with the pose; default true.

sprite.description: Draws a texture or an atlas frame at the entity's pose.

blocks.description: Whether its cell is impassable to paths while it stands there; default true.

occupant.description: Stands on the grid cell under its pose, where paths and game code see it.

nineSlice.description: Insets in texture px; default the import's.

turn.description: Turn with the pose; default true.

sprite.description: Draws a texture or an atlas frame at the entity's pose.
sprite.title: sprite

blocks.description: Whether its cell is impassable to paths while it stands there; default true.

occupant.description: Stands on the grid cell under its pose, where paths and game code see it.
occupant.title: occupant

ticks.description: Ticks until it goes; give this or `ms`.

ms.description: Milliseconds until it goes, rounded to ticks at the run's rate; give this or `ticks`.

lifetime.description: Destroys or disables the entity a time after it spawns or is enabled.
lifetime.title: lifetime

behaviors.description: Behavior blocks by name: each a typed set of fields this entity carries. `{}` carries a behavior with all its defaults; the type's required behaviors are always present.
behaviors.title: Behaviors

oneOf.description: spawn: Player spawn point: where the player's feet start.

Entity.description: An entity with a stable id. `type` picks the registered type and which fields apply.

BodyShape.description: A shape tuple: ["box", cx, cy, hw, hh, rotDeg?] | ["circle", cx, cy, r] | ["capsule", cx, cy, halfLen, r, rotDeg?] | ["poly", x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, ...]. Integer pixels, y is down.

oneOf.title: box
oneOf.description: Axis-aligned box (a Rapier cuboid) by centre and half-extents, optionally rotated about its centre.

prefixItems.description: Rotation in integer degrees, clockwise on screen (y is down). Omitted means 0.

oneOf.title: circle
oneOf.description: Circle (a Rapier ball) by centre and radius.

oneOf.title: capsule
oneOf.description: Capsule, vertical before rotation: a segment of half-length halfLen through the centre, swept by radius r.

prefixItems.description: Half the length of the inner segment.
Rotation in integer degrees, clockwise on screen (y is down). Omitted means 0.

oneOf.title: poly
oneOf.description: Convex polygon as flat x, y pairs (at least 3 points). Points are absolute; the loader centres the body on their centroid. Concave outlines must be split or drawn as a chain.

pts.description: Waypoints in absolute world px. The entity's shape is centred on each point in turn. At least 2, no repeats.
pts.title: Waypoints

mode.description: ping_pong: travel to the last point, then back. loop: after the last point, travel back to the first along the closing segment.
mode.title: Mode

speed.description: Travel speed along the path, px per second; must be > 0.
speed.title: Speed

pauseMs.description: How long it waits at each waypoint, in milliseconds. Omitted means 0.
pauseMs.title: Pause

Path.description: A waypoint path with linear segments.
Path.title: Path

Polygon.description: A simple polygon: ["poly", x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, ...], concave allowed. Integer pixels, y is down.

oneOf.title: poly
oneOf.description: Simple polygon as flat x, y pairs (at least 3 points), convex or concave; its edges may not cross. Points are absolute.
